name: marketing-ideas
description: Helps a small team decide which marketing ideas deserve money, and whether a test worked. Describe your product and it suggests one main bet and two cheap tests, dropping ideas that break disclosure or platform rules; paste your own list and it ranks it. For one idea, such as a sponsorship or a booth, it works out the most you can pay per customer and per click and whether a quoted price fits. It sets pass and stop lines before a test and reads the results afterwards, showing each rate with its 95% range. Every number is yours or a labelled assumption.
